top_signals.title: Seven & i abandons investment talks with Poland’s Zabka
top_signals.summary: Seven & i was unable to reach a deal that would be "in the best interests" of the company and its shareholders, it said in a statement Saturday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
